simple.meaning: הֹוָה (hôvâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “ruin.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: הֹוָה (H1943) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 47:11, with occurrences in Isaiah, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הֹוָה (H1943) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in הֹוָה (H1943) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: הֹוָה (hôvâh) / H1943 is traced through Isaiah 47:11, Ezekiel 7:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
